name: Aubergine
grown_as: A tender annual grown in a greenhouse or warm sunny spot in the UK. Most varieties have dark purple oval fruit; some are white, striped or long and thin. Drawn as the usual dark purple oval kind. ⚠️ CHECK
habit: A bushy upright plant 60 to 90 cm, with branching, slightly woody, grey-felted stems, sometimes with a few prickles.

leaf.outline: Large, broadly oval, 10 to 20 cm, with the edge in shallow broad wavy lobes
leaf.margin: Wavy, in shallow rounded lobes; no fine teeth
leaf.veins: Pinnate, 4 to 6 pairs of side veins, often purplish; sometimes small prickles on the midrib
leaf.surface: Soft, thick, felted with star-shaped hairs, especially beneath
leaf.colour: Grey-green, paler beneath, the veins often purple-tinged

flower.form: A star-shaped or shallow saucer flower, drooping, with a yellow cone of stamens
flower.petals: Five to seven, joined for half their length into a wheel with broad pointed lobes, slightly crinkled
flower.centre: Thick yellow stamens joined into a cone pointing forward
flower.behind: A large, thick, felted calyx with 5 to 7 lobes, often purple-tinged and prickly, that stays on the fruit
flower.carried: Singly or in twos or threes on short stalks from the stem, opposite the leaves, nodding

fruit: A large, glossy, oval to teardrop berry 10 to 20 cm, deep purple-black, hanging from the stem. The big green, felted, often prickly calyx covers its top like a cap. Seeds small, flat, rounded, pale buff, about 3 mm.
seedling: Two oval seed leaves, broader and rounder than a tomato's; the first true leaf simple, oval and grey-felted.

leaf: a big simple oval leaf with a wavy, shallowly lobed edge
bloom: a violet star of joined petals
a large thick calyx behind it
seedling: a simple oval grey-felted first leaf
young: big grey-green felted leaves with wavy edges
flower: drooping violet flowers on short stalks
flowers set on the stem opposite or between the leaves
crop: glossy dark purple oval fruit hanging down, each with a green calyx cap

look_alikes: Potato and tomato flowers have the same stamen cone but smaller and the leaves are pinnate. Chilli pepper has smooth, glossy, untoothed leaves and white flowers.
